Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Distributed Systems [CSE_3251]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Identify the major design challenges in building distributed systems.                                (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Show the client-server and peer-to-peer architectural styles.                                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Illustrate an example architecture of a distributed system such as Google File System (GFS).         (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Show the layers involved in communication in distributed systems.                                    (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Demonstrate the role of stubs in RPC implementation.                                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Outline multicast communication and its applications.                                                (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Manipulate the following words Names, Identifiers, and Addresses in distributed systems.             (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Demonstrate the concept of flat naming with an example.                                              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Illustrate the structured naming and how name resolution is performed.                               (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Show concept of clock synchronization? Why is it needed?                                             (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

B)                Illustrate Lamport's logical clock with an example.                                                   (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Describe distributed mutual exclusion algorithm.                                                      (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
5)                        Show consistency and replication in distributed systems.                                              (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Outline session guarantees used in client-centric consistency.                                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Compare primary-based and replicated-write consistency protocols.                                     (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"
